content.comment_body: Hello, my system currently has [product_name] version [version_no] installed. The project I want to restore was created with [product_name] version [version_no] in network project mode, not diagram mode. I would like to know if I can restore this program even though my system uses an earlier version.

Hello, if you have the full (not demo) [product_name] version [version_no] installed, you should be able to update easily to the latest version, which is [version_no]. The update can be downloaded from [url]. By installing the newest version, the version differences will no longer be an issue. You can always upgrade your program file, but downgrading is not supported. So, updating both the software and your program file to the latest version should resolve your issue.

This only applies if the devices are not the FS4 type. For FS4 devices, you will need [product_name] version [version_no] or newer. The upgrade from [version_no] to [version_no] is available for free. You can find the upgrade at [url]. After downloading the full upgrade package, launch the setup file 'install.htm' in the relevant upgrade installers folder to proceed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter issues when trying to open or restore project files created with newer versions of [product_name] on systems running an older version. The advice provided is to upgrade the software as this is straightforward, whereas downgrading or using older versions with files created in newer ones is not possible and may interrupt workflow if users lack access to the necessary software update.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to easily open and restore project files created in newer versions with their existing software installation, or have access to a simple upgrade solution.
